# Deterministic image replay

Generated by `python3 tools/camera-sim/generate.py testdata/vision`.
`sequence.json` contains only image paths, dimensions and camera calibrations;
no impact coordinates, scoring labels or expected events are fed to detection.

PGM files are raw internal grayscale acquisition fixtures. The service converts
frames to PNG for its browser-displayable camera API. Frames repeat three times
for temporal stability; the last image is held after EOF.

Run:

```sh
python3 services/detector/main.py --source replay --replay testdata/vision/sequence.json
python3 -m unittest discover -s services/detector -p 'test_*.py'
```

This is a planar-marker synthetic test, not evidence of live dart detection.
See `services/detector/README.md` for the exact API and limitations.
